title: Sam Altman Just Admitted AGI Is Here
full_monologue: **Sam Altman just admitted AGI is here.** This changes everything. In a recent interview, he hinted that we’re no longer just dreaming about artificial general intelligence—we’re living it. The implications are staggering. From self-driving cars to AI doctors, the future is unfolding faster than we expected. But what does this mean for jobs, creativity, and humanity’s role in this new era? Let me know your thoughts in the comments.
